purpose: Prove the AIWorks supervisor works end to end after the split from Engineering Platform: governance checkout, dispatch, independent verification and publication.

authorization.grantedBy: owner (netbka), delegated to the owner's main session
authorization.text: The owner approved the AIWorks split on 2026-10-11, including the live switchover and a smoke campaign once AIWorks runs, and gave the go on 2026-10-12. Report-only: no code, branch, PR, label or issue-state change; the supervisor posts the verified report on netbka/aiworks#2. No production, Docker, SQL, live providers or browsers. One worker; never merge or deploy. Provider: Claude only.

constraints: Report-only campaign for netbka/aiworks#2. Do not change files, branches, PRs, labels or issue state; do not comment yourself. The supervisor posts the verified report.
Use the repository at current main only. No production access, Docker, SQL, live providers, browser tests, paid services or deploys.
Never read .env contents, credentials, the supervisor data directory or other local runtime state.

tasks.title: Check that the AIWorks runbooks match the repository
tasks.outcome: A short report saying whether the documented commands, config keys, scripts and task names exist in the code.
tasks.goal: Read README.md, AGENTS.md and docs/SUPERVISOR.md section 6 at current main. For each documented command, config key, error code, script and Windows task name, check that the code under src/ and scripts/ defines it, citing file and line. Report a table: item, where documented, where defined, match yes/no. Keep it under 40 rows.
acceptance: The report has the table with a file:line citation for every row marked as a match.
Every mismatch names both the documented text and what the code does.
The report makes no code or document change.
